rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Shrub.
Registration name: DELviola
rows.Class: Hybrid Tea, Shrub. (Series: Grand Parfums Collection)
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Lilac-pink. Strong, citrus, fruity, old rose, tangerine fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 35" (80 to 90cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Protect tender new spring growth from hard freezes that may cause canker, die-back and death of the plant. . Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood.. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .

fragrance: Strong, citrus, fruity, old rose, tangerine fragrance.
